strings.en: I never did mind a long shot...!
I won't let you do as you please!
Want to bet on whether this drops you...?
There won't be a second time...!
That move... will be your undoing!
You can't win with that hand...!
Don't think you'll get off lightly...!
Clearing out the nearest enemy first.
No folding out of this game now.
Shooting's not my strong suit./　...But no time to complain.
At this range, you don't stand a chance!
No one beats me on closing speed!
Just the range for Alt and me...!
The nail that sticks out gets shot...!
You'll get more than burned, So-Des.
Jua-Mu, I've no interest in your drivel.
Jua-Mu, I'll punch through you, obsession and all.
Speed of the charge decides this...!
Fu-Ruu... I won't let you keep your distance!
A black Raftclans... My kind of opponent.
Gu-Landon, you don't deserve the throne.
Whoever you are, if you're an enemy, you go down.
No idea what you're after, but...
Iradoya... Easy to read, in a way.
How long will that smug act last...!
Forced breakthrough... Just our kind of mission.
A frontal breakthrough... Suits me fine.
I'm taking you down, scythe and all, Vort!
It's simple. For both of us.
Vort, don't think you can stop us.
Reggiane, I'll have you step aside.
At that size, no need to aim too carefully.
Out of your league... Your bet doesn't stand!
Whoever's pulling the strings, the job's the same.
So you're shady in more than looks.
Learn firsthand what becomes/　of those who meddle in this world.
Whatever that body is, I'll simply pierce it...!
I'll smash you, armor and all...!
I'll close in before it does...!
Whatever its tone, it's the same as the rest.
XN-L, there's no place for you/　in this world. Let's go...!
God or giant, I don't care./　I'm sinking you. Here and now!
Don't think you can keep up with us forever.
That stubbornness will be your undoing...!
No matter how often you come to Earth,/　the result's the same.
We won't let Golaikunru have its way.
Whatever its origins, an enemy's an enemy.
A Big Shoulder can't stop me.
I won't lose a collision to a Big Shoulder.
The commander unit... I'll take the head!
Those moves... That one's the ace...!
Thorn... You're the one getting pricked.
I'll break you, thorns and all.
I'll crush you, claw and all.
Those thrusters.../　It's probably got decent charging power.
I'm used to dealing with monsters.
However many appear, I'll crush them all.
No matter how many of you crawl out...!
No matter what kind of monster...!
Getting bigger doesn't change the job.
Just makes it easier to hit.
I can't let it out of here...!
Lamaris Ida... There's no place for you here.
Kaana or Ida,/　every Lamaris gets annihilated.
A bad bet... Fine by me.
I'm used to dealing with monsters...!
Seems I'm fated to keep meeting monsters...!
My turn, then... Here I go...!
Failing to take me down will cost you...!
The gap isn't as wide.../　as you think...!
I suppose I held out this long... Ngh!
I blew it! ...Don't go down yet!
Don't relax till it's fully destroyed...!
A good hand.../　But you don't know mine...!
Ngh... Alt, hold out a little longer...!
Fragile...!/　Ngh... What good is mobility...!
Fast machines always end up like this...!/　Tch...!
At this rate, I'll really be a ghost.../　That's not even funny...!
Took too many hits after all!/　But Jigan... keep moving...!
Still holding...? If I can't dodge,/　then you'd better hold, Grungust...!
Even Grungust's armor ends up like this./　...What now...?
Herluga, all you'll gain here is defeat...!
...With a body that big,/　there's bound to be an opening...!
I will end you... Just you wait, XN-L!
You're as strong as you look...!
Can't dodge it...!/　But it's far from finishing me...!
One or two more hits, I'd say.../　Ngh!
I avoided a fatal hit, but...
Did I step in too far?!
Finally warming up, huh./　...Now it begins...
Ngh...! Did I misjudge the distance...?!
If I worried over damage like this,/　I couldn't pilot this thing...!
It took a lot of armor damage, but.../　nothing worth worrying about...!
This much is fine... Right, Alt?
Checking damage... Still fine, it seems.
It may be flimsy, but.../　this much is no problem...!
More damage than I expected...?!/　Tch, the armor's way too thin...!
It's too soon to become a real ghost...!
Tch, the strongest shield in name only?!
It's got a huge frame./　The armor ought to match it...!
Not all talk, I see, Jua-Mu.
Al-Van's reach is/　wider than I thought...!
...So the title of Knight isn't just for show.
I have to get inside Zee-Gadin's guard...!
I see, this power... But it seems/　it can't finish me in one blow...!
I can't give that woman time.
The Cross Gate aside,/　that machine must have its limits...!
Tch, I couldn't spot his cheat...!
I let the Skull Knight close in...!
Crystal Dragoon... It's nimbler than it looks.
Damn XN-L, that's a nasty attack...!
I let Thorn score a direct hit...!
I've no intention of joining the ghosts...!
So they're relying on brute force too...!
Surface armor damage... Not done yet.
Don't think this'll be enough to stop me.
Shakes a lot for so little damage.
You think a move like that will take me down?
Little hits add up, huh...?/　I'd rather not take many...
Nowhere near enough to pierce this armor.
Toughness is my edge. I can keep going!
Thick armor's its one strong point...!
Grazed...?!/　Can't hide how heavy this unit is...!
Hm...? This much impact from a graze.../　It really is soft...!
With armor this thin.../　I'd rather not take even this much...
Ngh...!/　Gespenst... don't go down yet!
That won't be enough/　to lay this ghost to rest...!
The strongest shield is no empty title!
They named it a Super Fighter, after all./　It can take this much.
That didn't go as planned, did it, Karo-Ran?
That won't slow me down, Gu-Landon.
So the man leading the knights is only this good.
I won't crumble that easily, Iradoya.
So there's no need to even aim, is that it?
Looks like the Cross Gate is too much for you.
With four eyes, I guess your aim would be good...!
It doesn't cut to the bone.
You'd wipe out intelligent life with power like that...?
So this is all a deity ship can do.
Those thorns aren't all that sharp.
Even fused, this is all you've got?
Ares Geist... So it's biting back!
For all those endless moves, that was shallow.
If I move early... I can manage this!
You expect to hit me with that?
I'm not about to just sit here/　and take it, either...!
I won't let you hit me that easily...!
Even the Alt can manage this much.
Don't think I'm a pushover/　just because I'm heavy...!
I move better than I look...!
If I can't evade,/　it's over before it starts...!
If mobility's all you've got.../　then dodge this!
No matter how strong the attack, if I focus on evading!
Your strike was too shallow, Vort.
Is that the best you can do, Reggiane?
Not as nimble as it looks, it seems.
The bigger it gets, the easier it is to read.
It's certainly faster than before, but...
This time, I win the bet...!
Type Haken... Not a bad reaction.
Smells like cheating, but.../　I'll take the barrier's help.
Get through this and there's still armor./　I won't be easy prey.
...Tch, I wasted too much early on...!
...Tch, live ammo's easy to handle,/　but the ammo count...
Can't do anything unless I close in...
From this range... I'll cover you!
Worship your big sister, Deadpan Boobs.
Mind if I spill all your secrets? Red Seaweed.
Mind if I tug on them from both sides?/　Those black panties.
Is that all this Bang-Bang Kaiser can do?
What are you doing? I'll take/　the final shot, Excellen.
Fall back, Excellen! I'm going in too!
Lieutenant Katina, I'll back you up...!
Ryusei, leave the rest to me.
Kusuha, leave the rest to me.
Masaki, I'm moving in to support...!
Arado, Focus on what's in front of you.
Major, I'm moving in to support.
Raul, leave the rest to me.
Axel, I'll be the one to finish him...!
Leave the rest to me, Arieil.
Hugo, I'll take it from here.
Leave that one to me, Hugo.
Fall back, Aqua. I'll handle the rest.
Josh, leave the rest to me.
Though the odds aren't bad this time...!
Rim, I'll take it from here.
Akimi, leave the finish to me.
Good job drawing them in, Akemi.
I'll have to push it a little...!
Moving to cover! This one's made for Alt!
It's slow, but the armor's thick!
The odds on that bet are bad...!
I've still got cards left to play...!
Let's switch up the usual pattern!
Okay now,/　let's give my rampaging little ghost a whirl!
You won't read me. Changing patterns.
Got your back! ...Or so you thought!
...That was a serious finish, coming from you.
Trump card... I mean, our fireworks of love!
Understood, Lieutenant Kyosuke./　I'll provide support.
We're both Alts, so to speak./　Easy to sync up.
It didn't go as smoothly/　as it does for Lieutenant Excellen...
I'm not much of a shot...
But I've already got a lock on you...!
I don't wear my hair like this/　for show or on a whim...!
Boost! All that's left is to ram it...!
Each one's a custom titanium round...!
It's got far more powder than it needs.
Take the hit and see how strong it is!
Maximum output...!/　Grungust, show me what you can do!
A sword handles well enough too...!
Don't think the horns are all I've got!
I don't get the Doctor's taste, but...
I don't carry these pincers/　just for show...!
I'm betting it all on this attack...!
The chips are in... no turning back now.
Bilgear, show me what you can do...!
I've got gear like this too...!
Set to E Mode./　...I'll land it somehow...!
Long-range attacks aren't my style.../　but it can't be helped...!
Set to B Mode./　...I'll land it somehow...!
These are live rounds too./　...Not quite the same, though.
If you're Weiss's successor, prove it...!
If this connects... you won't walk away clean!
In a slugfest... I won't be outdone!
Sorry, but I'm used to this range...!
I'll take you all on at once...!/　Jigan, I'm counting on you!
Sorry, but ramming is my specialty...!
In close combat, I won't be outdone!
Don't think you can stop me!
Not that I'm much good with weapons like this.
If just a few more shots hit... that's enough!
Can you dodge the Shishioh's blade?!
It's a bit dated, but power is power!
It's a bigger caliber than before.../　Take the hit and see how strong it is!
I'll just shoot right through it!
Weapons like this/　suit me better...!
Blade Tonfa,/　time to put you to use...!
I'm not great at what comes next, but...!
At this range, can you stop me...!
I don't expect this to finish you...!
At this range, you can't escape!
I didn't add more stakes/　on a whim...!
This is the hand I'm playing...!
If this hits, you're done for!
If you're meant to surpass the Final...
My stars aren't usually the best,/　but this one's special.
Looks like your luck ran out anyway.
Twin Beam Cannon! Find your mark!
It's basically a tank's main cannon./　...I'll land it...!
No holding back... take it all!
I'll take the lead. Let's go!
Whatever the armor, I'll smash it!
One blow to finish it, Type-3!
Show me you're worth the cost...!
Making a Tesla Drive disposable.../　Now that's extravagant...!
It's a pretty shady weapon, but...
Its power is the real deal!
Whatever the armor, I'll just pierce it.
Though it's a pain to catch.
Can't afford to say that, though.
This is no ordinary Slash Ripper...!
A bit big, but it's a weapon made for me.
Code DTD activated~ Leave it to me!
Or maybe I'm the one who played it.
This'll be more than a burn!
Can't worry about the cost now.
Its performance and power are proven...!
Don't underestimate how fast this thing starts...!
I won't lose a head-on clash...!!
I won't miss at this range...!
This one's my kind of weapon too.
I'll stop him in his tracks!
Go ahead, try and stop it!
Not the trump card I'd prefer, but...!
